title: UCO Kudos · Publicar Kudo de punta a punta

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let L = union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL, ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| extend app = coalesce(column_ifexists('ContainerAppName_s', ''), column_ifexists('ContainerAppName', '')),
         log = coalesce(column_ifexists('Log_s', ''), column_ifexists('Log', ''));
L | where app == 'ca-kudos-waf' and log has 'ModSecurity: Access denied' | summarize valor = count()

panels.title: Entrada: WAF (ModSecurity + OWASP CRS) y API Gateway

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let L = union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL, ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| extend app = coalesce(column_ifexists('ContainerAppName_s', ''), column_ifexists('ContainerAppName', '')),
         log = coalesce(column_ifexists('Log_s', ''), column_ifexists('Log', ''));
L | where app == 'ca-kudos-waf' | extend codigo = extract(@'HTTP/[0-9.]+" ([0-9]{3}) ', 1, log) | where isnotempty(codigo) | summarize peticiones = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), codigo | order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: WAF · reglas OWASP CRS que más bloquean

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let L = union isfuzzy=true ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL, ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| extend app = coalesce(column_ifexists('ContainerAppName_s', ''), column_ifexists('ContainerAppName', '')),
         log = coalesce(column_ifexists('Log_s', ''), column_ifexists('Log', ''));
L | where app == 'ca-kudos-waf' and log has 'ModSecurity: Access denied' | extend regla = extract(@'\[id "([0-9]+)"\]', 1, log), mensaje = extract(@'\[msg "([^"]+)"\]', 1, log) | summarize bloqueos = count() by regla, mensaje | top 10 by bloqueos
